content.short: PingMe is a stablecoin payments app on Monad sending crypto by email, QR or message.
content.description: PingMe lets someone send stablecoins to an email address, a QR code or a message thread rather than a hex address, on Monad. Addressing is the part of crypto payments that most obviously fails ordinary expectations, and removing it is worth more to a first-time user than any fee saving.
content.meta: Send stablecoins to an email address or QR code instead of a hex string.
